title: ai/sessions/<id>.json
description: One running MCP server (one assistant session), written when it starts and every minute after (the heartbeat), removed when it stops. A session whose 'alive' (or 'active') is more than 150 seconds old, or whose process is gone, is no longer counted; its file is removed once 1500 seconds old.

cwd.description: The folder the assistant works in.

push.description: Whether the server pushes review results into the session (Claude Code).

active.description: The last tool call (or the start).
